instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Asset management firm managing $2.5B AUM across 6 mutual funds and discretionary mandates for institutional investors and family offices. Investment strategies span European equities, fixed income, and multi-asset classes. We are evaluating machine learning overlays for portfolio risk monitoring and alternative data integration for equity research to maintain alpha generation.
answers.pastInitiatives: We installed IoT sensors on 40% of our production equipment to monitor utilization and predict failures, reducing unplanned downtime by 15%. This required significant coordination with our legacy ERP system for data ingestion. Now we are piloting a low-cost cloud-based analytics tool specifically designed to identify correlation risks across disparate asset classes.
answers.strategicGoals: Customer retention has declined from 92% to 84% over the past 18 months, primarily among our mid-tier and enterprise segments who are sensitive to valuation shifts. Exit interviews consistently cite product stagnation and poor digital self-service tools as reasons for leaving. We need to urgently modernize our customer-facing technology and proactively address these specific pain points driving churn before the trend becomes irreversible in this competitive micro-market.
answers.additionalContext: The firm operates under stringent MiFID II guidelines, necessitating careful review of any new client onboarding workflows or data handling capabilities.
answers.teamSize: We have 2 generalist developers who split their time between maintaining our existing systems, handling customer support escalations, and occasionally prototyping new features. There is no dedicated innovation or R&D role — innovation happens when these developers have spare cycles between urgent operational tasks, which is rare.

opportunities.title: Automated Compliance Reporting RPA
opportunities.rationale: Implementing Robotic Process Automation (RPA) to automate the data extraction for quarterly regulatory filings will reduce manual error risk and free up developer time.

first_actions: Identify top 3 compliance reports requiring manual data entry.
Select a low-code RPA tool pilot (e.g., UiPath Community Edition).
Map the existing data pipeline to identify automation opportunities.
resources_needed: 10 hours of developer time for mapping
Subscription/licensing cost for basic RPA tool
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduce manual compliance data entry hours by 40% within Q3.
milestones: Month 1: Tool selection and proof of concept completion.
Month 2: Integration into a single reporting workflow.
Month 3: Full deployment for one key regulatory report.

opportunities.title: AI-Driven Hyper-Personalized Risk Alerts
opportunities.rationale: Leveraging the existing ML infrastructure to move beyond standard risk monitoring and create dynamic, predictive alerts tailored specifically to individual client portfolio volatility.

first_actions: Define clear parameters for 'hyper-personalization' based on client segmentation data.
Allocate 50% of developer time for model fine-tuning and UI prototype design.
Establish a dedicated Slack channel for rapid feedback from portfolio managers.
resources_needed: Increased GPU access or specialized cloud compute cost
execution_plan.success_metric: Increase client engagement score related to proactive alerts by 20% within 6 months.
milestones: Month 1-2: Prototype and backtesting of the new alert engine.
Month 3: Internal pilot program with 5 key clients.
Month 4: Full integration into the self-service portal.

next_steps.action: Conduct a deep dive feasibility study on RPA adoption for compliance reporting.
Launch an immediate 'Customer Experience Quick Win' project focused solely on the most cited self-service pain points.

key_weaknesses: Severe resource constraints resulting in no dedicated innovation budget or R&D headcount, forcing reliance on opportunistic side projects.
Partial and fragmented innovation process that lacks clear governance or scaling mechanisms for successful pilots.
High dependency on owner-led decision-making which can lead to 'strategy drift' during short time horizons as market conditions shift.
Low digital maturity (Level 2) limiting the firm's ability to leverage advanced automation and self-service tools effectively.
